title: One-time settlement vs ongoing maintenance - strategic considerations for clients
p1:
A quick settlement may feel like the easiest solution. But could closing the matter today create bigger challenges tomorrow?

Many people assume that accepting a one-time payment is always better because it brings immediate certainty.
p2:
The reality is more strategic. A lump-sum settlement and ongoing maintenance serve different needs.

A one-time settlement gives immediate financial control, but it also means giving up future claims. Ongoing maintenance may provide long-term support, but it can involve uncertainty, delays, or changing circumstances.
p3:
The right choice depends on factors like future expenses, financial stability, inflation, earning capacity, and the ability to manage money over time.

A decision that looks attractive today may not always protect future needs. The smartest approach is not choosing the bigger number, but choosing the option that fits the person's long-term situation.
conclusion: If you had to choose, would you prefer the certainty of a one-time settlement or the security of ongoing maintenance? What factors would influence your decision?
